lineage.description: Population data from Cook Islands census (2011) was spatially intersected with 1km coastal buffer zones to quantify populations at coastal proximity. Enumeration area boundaries and population counts were combined with a 1km buffer derived from coastline data to identify and measure populations within coastal risk zones.
